name: Real satellite, relief and historical map layers
description: Switch between real satellite imagery, DEM hillshade and historical layers while checking city alignment and sources.
steps: Open campaign centred on Apulia
Verify SATELLITE is selected and credit names EOxCloudless 2016
Switch REAL RELIEF and inspect terrain and source credit
Switch HISTORIC, zoom to ITALIA, switch SATELLITE and refresh
expected: Basemap selector works with existing campaign, town markers remain geographically aligned, credits follow selected layer and the chosen mode persists on refresh.

name: Recruit and retain a Roman campaign
description: Recruit units from the Canusium settlement and verify that the campaign persists after refresh.
steps: Open the campaign and select Canusium
Click Recruit 150 and verify manpower and treasury decrease
Refresh the page and inspect the army and resources
expected: The field army remains larger by 150 and treasury and manpower remain reduced after refresh.

name: World map and local town controls work on mobile
description: Check that geographically grounded map navigation works on a narrow touchscreen.
steps: Open the game on a mobile viewport
Tap WORLD then ITALIA then APULIA
Tap the DETAILS button and inspect Canusium settlement data
expected: All three map scales are usable, coastline is drawn, and Canusium details open without controls falling off-screen.

name: Prevent impossible recruitment
description: Recruiting cannot create troops out of thin air when resources are exhausted.
steps: Select Canusium
Click Recruit 150 repeatedly until the treasury or manpower is exhausted
Try recruiting one additional time
expected: A clear insufficient-resource warning appears and resources never become negative.

name: Tactical 3D engine remains playable
description: The original ROMA Three.js scene loads in an isolated same-origin iframe and can be exited without changing campaign resources.
steps: Select Canusium and press INSPECT IN 3D
Wait for the original Challenger 3D battlefield to appear
Click Return to campaign
expected: The original ROMA 3D scene loads and is playable; returning restores the strategic map with campaign state intact.

name: Battle application is idempotent
description: Verify an encounter affects both sides once and returns to the campaign.
steps: Select Canusium and use MARCH TO CANNAE
Advance one day until the two armies meet
Choose AUTO RESOLVE
Inspect Roman and Carthaginian army strengths and advance a day
expected: Battle losses apply once, the encounter dialog disappears, and the campaign can continue without duplicate casualties.

name: Truthful campaign economics and army travel
description: Regression test protecting campaign gameplay clarity without changing tactical engine.
steps: Open Canusium; observe wood, stone, iron, and net day forecast
Verify granary shows 65 wood + 25 stone + 35 coin, fortification shows 70 wood + 60 stone + 65 coin, recruit shows 95 coin + 65 grain + 28 iron + 150 manpower
Issue a march from Canusium toward Luceria, advance one day, verify the army is between source and destination rather than at destination
Resolve any non-Cannae encounter as Romans and confirm the Cannae mission remains active
expected: All actual costs are shown, resource forecast and movement reflect simulation, and Cannae cannot be marked secure by an unrelated win.

name: Export geographically labelled, non-invasive battle research brief
description: Exports a draft briefing without modifying the preserved battle runtime or changing the campaign state.
steps: Select Cannae and read battlefield scout
Export battle brief
Confirm JSON includes site Cannae, approximate coordinates, campaign army metadata, DEM unavailable, source notes and draft-only status
Return to campaign and use Inspect in 3D, then return
expected: JSON download represents current state and site accurately, and no battle state changes or forced tactical engine modifications occur.
